resources.string: Watches for system popups, time-limit blocks and parental-control screens that appear over the games you selected, and closes them automatically. Works on every Android brand. Nothing is read, stored or sent anywhere.
Slide the toggle below to wake the shield.
Tap a game below to arm protection.
Blocking screens over your games are closed automatically.
Automatically detects and dismisses surface-level manufacturer time-limit overlays — like standard VIVO, Xiaomi, and Oppo popup timers — by instantly simulating a system \'Back\' command.

It cannot bypass deep kernel-level locks or aggressive platform blocks (like Google Family Link) if the Android OS completely freezes background third-party processes or deactivates the Accessibility layer.
If your phone is severely lagging or low on RAM while playing heavy games like Delta Force, the shield might need a fraction of a second to react.
No popups dismissed yet — your shield is quiet.
Android or your phone\'s battery manager turned off the accessibility service. The shield cannot protect your games until it is back on.
Phone brands hide battery settings in different places. Follow the path for your device — menu names vary slightly between OS versions.
Open the Security app → Battery → Battery saver
Find Gaming Shield and set it to No restrictions
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Gaming Shield → turn on Autostart
Settings → Apps → App management → Gaming Shield
Battery usage → enable Allow background activity
Launch settings → allow Auto-launch and Background running
Open Sleeping apps → Never sleeping apps → add Gaming Shield
Turn off Put unused apps to sleep for the shield
Open i Manager → Power save (or Settings → Battery)
Background power consumption → Gaming Shield → Allow
Disable Battery optimization so the shield is never dozed
Couldn\'t load your apps. Please reopen the screen.
The shield hit a snag — logged and still running.
To ensure your shield stays active during long matches, please allow notifications.
Gaming Shield is active and monitoring.
This app acts like a background shield. It stays quietly alert while you play your favorite games, watching for sudden system time-limit blocks.
To quickly dismiss blocking screens, the app needs permission. Tap the button below, find our app name under \'Installed Services\' or \'Accessibility\', and turn it ON.
Android systems love to close background apps to save battery. To keep your shield active, open your phone\'s multitasking menu, press down on this app, and click the \'Lock\' padlock icon.
